verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://appwrite.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-targeted content, and docs.md returns HTTP 200 and points to a full nested documentation llms.txt index. First-party docs add more agent-oriented material: any docs page is available as raw Markdown via a .md suffix, every page has a Copy page Markdown button, and open-source Skills Markdown files give agents SDK-accurate context. Together these cover both llms.txt and agent-oriented docs, with hands-on probe corroboration.
